fields.name: SqlServerProvider.DataProviderServiceFactory provider-neutral execution surface
fields.contract: Provides SQL Server-specific resources to provider-neutral execution callers. NewConnection returns a SQL Server database connection initialized from the supplied connection string. NewCommand returns a SQL Server command bound to the supplied SQL Server connection and named by the supplied stored-procedure string. SetParameters populates a destination command from SQL Server source parameters: it copies every source parameter when no query parameter names are supplied, or copies only requested names after SQL parameter-name normalization; supplied values replace copied values only for matching parameter names.
